description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as issue date, draft number, issuer information, payee information, acceptor information, and draft amount
description_zh: 支持包括出票日期、票据号码、出票人信息、收票人信息、承兑人信息、票据金额等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-bank-acceptance --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN016eNk0d1ubhKP4y6gK_!!6000000006056-2-tps-631-570.png' --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBankAcceptance

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide exactly one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide exactly one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
